issues: 纯色 #0a0b10 平铺底，画面没有任何光源与层次
占位文案 "Your headline goes here" 直接上屏，像未完成的模板
字体栈只有 -apple-system,sans-serif，标题平涂纯白、字距只按 -0.5px 硬写
副标题 103f 才收完，尾段只留 11f 静置，关键信息没有呼吸时间
整段除逐词入场外完全死机位，落定后画面僵住
changes: 背景换成暗场柔光 Backdrop（主光居中偏上 + 极淡靛蓝余光 + 暗角）并覆盖 soft-light 颗粒防色带
文案换成产品级占位：主 4 词 "Make every launch count" / 副 5 词 "Plan, review and ship together"，词数与原 stagger 节奏一致
标题改系统 SF 字体栈 700 字重、-0.035em 字距，加上亮下暗的竖向微渐变；副标题改带冷调的 #8b91a8
时间窗前移：主 0.05–0.56、副 0.29–0.78，三通道同 p 的 outCubic 不变，副标题 88f 落定后留满约 25f 呼吸
整组全程极缓推近 1→1.018（smooth，起止速度为 0），blur 收敛到 0 时直接去掉 filter 保证落定后字形锐利
issuesEn: Flat #0a0b10 fill with no light source or depth
Placeholder copy "Your headline goes here" shown on screen, reads as an unfinished template
Font stack was just -apple-system,sans-serif; flat pure-white headline with a hard-coded -0.5px tracking
Subtitle only settled at 103f, leaving an 11f tail — no breathing room for the key message
Locked-off frame: once the words land the picture just freezes
changesEn: Dark soft-light Backdrop (centered key light, faint indigo spill, vignette) with soft-light grain against banding
Product-grade copy: 4-word headline "Make every launch count" / 5-word subtitle "Plan, review and ship together", word counts kept so the stagger rhythm is unchanged
SF system stack, 700 weight, -0.035em tracking and a subtle top-lit vertical gradient on the headline; cool-gray #8b91a8 subtitle
Windows moved earlier (title 0.05–0.56, subtitle 0.29–0.78) with the shared-p outCubic kept; subtitle lands at 88f leaving ~25f of hold
Whole group slowly pushes in 1→1.018 (smooth, zero velocity at both ends); blur filter removed once p reaches 1 so settled glyphs stay crisp
